segments.en: (75.) I heard in his name that he said: "There are with me people who are sometimes inflamed toward Hashem Yisburach — and are close to Hashem Yisburach truly. And they are then at a good level that even complete tzaddikim do not hold. But sometimes they fall from this etc. Would that this feeling of theirs would remain at the time they hold in the service of G-d — would that they held this level for long days and many years."
